newsitem.title: INDIA: IOC seeks $400 mln syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: IOC seeks $400 mln syndicated loan.

text.p: Syndication for a $400 million loan for Indian Oil Corp will begin on Thursday, an IOC official said.
The official, who did not wish to be identified, said HSBC Capital Markets, in association with Bank of America, will arrange the syndication.

The loan, aimed at funding IOC's import of crude oil, will be raised at 19 basis points above the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR). The syndication will close within three weeks, the official said.
The tenure of the loan will be for six months with an option for renewal for another six months.
